name: Python + Marimo Container
postCreateCommand: git config --global user.name 'Tl Yim (Codespaces)' && if [ "${GITHUB_USER}" = "tlyim" ]; then GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=$(curl -s https://gist.githubusercontent.com/tlyim/ebbea2d6ac7e91a8f24505000df00271/raw/email_alias.txt); [ -n "$GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL" ] && git config --global user.email "$GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL" || echo "WARNING: git user.email not set" >&2; fi && CONFIGURED=$(git config --global user.email 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CONFIGURED" ]; then echo "git user.email set to: $CONFIGURED"; else echo "WARNING: git user.email is not set - required for commits" >&2; fi && bash .devcontainer/setup.sh
